name: plasticity
description: Dynamic edge weight manager. Strengthens connections on successful use, weakens on failure, applies decay over time. Implements Hebbian-like learning for the graph.

commands.strengthen: +0.1 to matching edge weight (cap 1.0). Usage: strengthen <source_id> <target_id> [edge_type]
commands.weaken: -0.2 to matching edge weight (floor 0.0). Usage: weaken <source_id> <target_id> [edge_type]
commands.strengthen-type: +0.1 to all edges matching source_type->target_type. Usage: strengthen-type <source_type> <target_type> [edge_type] [amount]
commands.weaken-type: -0.2 to all edges matching source_type->target_type. Usage: weaken-type <source_type> <target_type> [edge_type] [amount]
commands.decay: Apply time-based decay to edges untouched for 14+ days. weight *= (1-0.05)^cycles
commands.status: Show edge weight distribution, weakest/strongest edges, by-type averages.
